description: Defines registers, constants, and inline functions for managing the ECIA (External Interrupt Controller) on MEC172X microcontroller, including GIRQ (Grouped Interrupt Request) handling and NVIC configuration.

methods.name: mchp_soc_ecia_girq_aggr_en
methods.description: Enables or disables aggregation for a specific GIRQ in ECIA.

methods.name: mchp_soc_ecia_girq_src_clr
methods.description: Clears a specific source pin in a GIRQ.

methods.name: mchp_soc_ecia_girq_src_clr_bitmap
methods.description: Clears multiple source pins in a GIRQ based on a bitmap.

methods.name: mchp_soc_ecia_girq_src_dis
methods.description: Disables a specific source pin in a GIRQ.

methods.name: mchp_soc_ecia_girq_src_en
methods.description: Enables a specific source pin in a GIRQ.

methods.name: mchp_soc_ecia_girq_result
methods.description: Returns the result register value for a specific GIRQ.
